projectDuplicates.title: Resolve duplicates of “{{name}}”
projectDuplicates.description: Compare the copies in this project before changing any files.
projectDuplicates.replace: Replace these copies with links to the shared copy
projectDuplicates.effect: Your agents keep access. Editing through any of these locations updates the same files. Links stay inside this project and move with it.
projectDuplicates.backups: The replaced folders are backed up in Recently removed for {{removedDays}} days. You can undo while those backups exist and the shared files have not changed.
projectDuplicates.global: Global and plugin copies are not changed here. Warnings about those copies may remain.
projectDuplicates.changedFiles: Files or folder permissions that differ
projectDuplicates.compareDocument: Compare the main documents below. Supporting-file differences are listed above. Review them in the project before resolving these copies.

status.identical: These copies contain identical files and permissions.
status.different: These copies differ. Nothing will be replaced. Review and reconcile the differences, then compare again.
status.unsupported: Loadout cannot safely resolve these copies yet.
status.resolved: Duplicate copies resolved. Your agents share one copy. Undo restores the previous folders; it will not overwrite later edits.
status.none: These locations already share one copy, or there is only one copy in this project. No changes are needed.

projectDuplicates.existingLinksHelp: These locations are shortcuts to an existing project copy, not extra copies. Loadout will leave these links in place during resolution and Undo.
